label: Tautology, Tractarian logical space and only logical necessity at the necessary-being node
summary: Owner-queued slice (step 5 of 5, refs #1784): Wittgenstein at the God-existence stage, logic first; Tractatus locators (4.46ff., 6.1ff., 6.37, 2.027, 4.1272, 4.211) are navigation only, no source claim. Findings. (1) Tautology is a definable sense, NECESSARY_16: a box-free formula of the existing Modal.Formula language true under every truth-value assignment. It strictly strengthens NECESSARY_14 K validity (strength order; certified difference: exactly truth-functionality; strictness by the K axiom instance with q := p, itself a substitution instance of a propositional tautology, so strictness comes only from the fragment restriction and every K-valid box formula is an equal witness; tautologous substitution instances such as box p -> box p are excluded and would be a distinct intermediate sense), coincides with NECESSARY_14 and, on an inhabited frame, with NECESSARY_13 on the truth-functional fragment, and is the classical truth-functional instance of NECESSARY_5 (contradictory denial; converse with excluded middle as an explicit antecedent), with the same relation to the frame-relative DenialContradictory. It does not bind NECESSARY_5 and is said of formulas, not beings. (2) Combinatorial logical space (every assignment realized at an accessible world, reusing Saturates) proves 'only logical necessity' for the box of that frame: a box-free formula is boxed exactly when it is a tautology. The universal frame on all assignments is S5. (3) Tractarian model: states of affairs are contingent; objects that exist at every world are NECESSARY_2 S5 box-existent, several at once, and their existence is not elementary; any box-free exact existence dictionary for a box-existent bearer is a tautology. So 'a necessary being exists' is no contradiction: with box it is not a truth-functional formula, its existence part is expressible only by a tautology, and with existence as an elementary atom its necessitation is false. (4) Joint route model: on one S5 frame over all assignments, the route's S5 frame premise and S5 necessary-being node hold together with logical space and only logical necessity for the states of affairs. The thesis, read as a claim about what can be said truth-functionally, therefore falsifies no route premise. (5) The conflicting variant is elementary existence (every combination of the candidates' existence realized at an accessible world); the box K node excludes it at its world (checked incompatibility; the weaker de dicto and tertia via nodes would also exclude it, not formalized, because of their legacy NECESSARY_11 links). Substantive-objection standard: target would be the NECESSARY_2 conjunct of STMT-NECESSARY-ROOT-BOX-K (on the cheapest route, the theory admission and existence dictionary premises that yield it); mechanism: the all-absent combination is accessible; independent justification: none recorded from the Tractatus, whose treatment of objects (persisting, 'there are objects' a pseudo-proposition) points the other way; a Humean distinct-existences recombination principle would be a different family, not investigated here. Result: from the Tractarian and later-Wittgenstein sources examined here, no substantive objection identified against any route premise. A known rival from another family, subtraction / metaphysical nihilism (Hume's dictum, the possibility of an empty world; attempt modal-spine-inert-emptiness-20261109), bears on the same incompatibility 065a9092 but has not yet been assessed against it. The model of persisting objects (2.022-2.027, navigation) realizes NECESSARY_2 box-existence of many simples; the Tractatus itself treats this as unsayable (4.1272). It supports neither uniqueness nor any root fact. The compatibility result concerns truth, not assertibility: it neither answers nor strengthens the meaning-level rival STMT-TLP-GOD-SENTENCES-NONSENSICAL, whose formal core for existence claims is the existence-dictionary law (4.461, 4.1272, 6.432, navigation). (6) Later Wittgenstein, stated rival only. Meaning as use: a use-theoretic challenge to the reading premise that the route's 'necessary being' is NECESSARY_2 in a frame class would need evidence that the relevant use differs from that reading; the use thesis supplies none, and the reading premise is an explicit analyst stipulation whose fit with use is an open interpretive question already covered by the coverage premise STMT-NECESSARY-SENSES-EXHAUSTIVE. Necessity as grammar (necessary propositions as rules of representation): it would target the de re reading of NECESSARY_2, but its positive support (rule-following and the arbitrariness of grammar) does not show that no de re modal truths exist, and the conventionalist reading is contested. No substantive objection identified under the standard; the existing #1090 classification (methodological challenge to the God-name leaves, PU 373 records) is unchanged. Rejected readings: binding NECESSARY_5 to Tautology (NECESSARY_5 stays a family over logics); identifying the route's box-existence with tautology of an existence formula (a definitional bridge with no content, as the 2026-11-05 reading attempt noted); recording elementary existence as a rival of the box K node (fails criterion 3). Frontier mechanism: the delta (open premises reaching the root 526 -> 524; 0b5da48f and e068a626 reported bare -> closed) comes from frontier rule (d): the stronger bare leaf 72861c3a now sits on top of the existing transcription chain kToFrame (abca2584) and frameToTheory (7761d430), which carry status from their premise. Since 72861c3a is equivalent to d912723b plus box-freeness (3f38adba), it adds no new source of warrant; the registration remains a valid conditional support option and establishes nothing.
blocker: Which propositions are elementary and whether the candidates' existence is among them is not decided by the formal results; the Tractatus-based case for elementary existence is absent. Next tests: (a) assess the subtraction / metaphysical-nihilism rival (Hume's dictum; possibility of an empty world, see modal-spine-inert-emptiness-20261109) against the incompatibility 065a9092; (b) formalize a Humean distinct-existences recombination principle over the route frame and test whether it supplies elementary existence for contingent candidates only (compatible with the node) or for all candidates (incompatible). A first-order logical-truth profile for existence sentences remains open.
